protocol.question: Can the positive SHORT attribution in D087 survive a real short-only full-capital counterfactual with unchanged predictions/trend states/prices/funding/cost/risk?

labels.classes: SHORT below -37bp; LONG above +37bp; CASH otherwise; missing future stays missing

protocol.adoption: Retain selective short as development research challenger only if actual short-only net positive in all four scenarios and net/DD/Sharpe has predeclared benefit versus same-rule LONG_SHORT in all four. Report actual risk against GMM/HOLD/CASH; no investment or bear-alpha qualification from seen development. Any nonpositive conditional net pauses this recipe; no tuning.
protocol.stopping: Only direction mask changes. Four new continuous122day 10k shared short-only accounts,20 controls reused by immutable reports/artifacts and unchanged financial/state inputs. Zero new fits/search; no copying direction attribution as standalone returns.

regime.policy: BEAR allows only original SHORT; all original LONG targets masked to cash; BULL/SIDEWAYS/HIGH_VOL_CRASH cash; never invert, risk reduction active
regime.source: Existing D085/D086 descriptive state definition, zero changed thresholds

direction_model_reuse.availability: Retrospective replay with identical preMarch fit data cutoff; not actual historical deployed model, no validation early stopping or parameter choice

control_reuse.scope: 16 same122day completed controls, unchanged input/financial kernels, no account resimulation; old GMM states preserved and regrouped by fixed rule only for descriptive contributions

extra_control_reuse.scope: Four fixed-rule long-short accounts, only direction mask differs, recorded fills/NAV remain unchanged; not new simulated accounts
